name: LDV
overview: SAIC-owned commercial and utility marque, imported by Ateco Automotive, famous for the T60 dual-cab ute (and Australia's first electric ute, the eT60), G10 and Deliver 9 commercial vans.
australian_history: Originally the British Leyland DAF Vehicles (LDV) van manufacturer, the brand was acquired by Chinese automotive giant SAIC Motor and launched in Australia in 2013 via independent distributor Ateco Automotive. Beginning with the V80 commercial van, LDV expanded with the G10 van/people mover and scored a major Australian breakthrough with the T60 dual-cab ute in 2017—the first Chinese-manufactured ute to achieve a five-star ANCAP safety rating. LDV introduced the D90 7-seat 4WD SUV, the Deliver 9 large van, and made Australian automotive history in 2022 by releasing the LDV eT60, Australia's very first commercially available all-electric ute.

models_catalog.name: T60 & eT60
models_catalog.overview: The Chinese 1-tonne ute that disrupted the Australian market. Debuting in 2017 as the first Chinese-manufactured vehicle to achieve a 5-star ANCAP safety rating, the LDV T60 delivered unmatched equipment-for-price value. The 2021 T60 Max raised the stakes with a class-leading 160kW/500Nm 2.0L Bi-Turbo diesel, while the 2022 eT60 became Australia's first commercially available electric factory ute.

generations.generation_name: LDV T60 Series I (Pro / Luxe / Trailrider)
generations.summary: First Chinese vehicle to receive a 5-star ANCAP safety rating. 2.8L VM Motori turbo-diesel (110kW/360Nm), 6-speed manual or Punch automatic, Eaton rear diff lock, and the Trailrider edition featuring Walkinshaw-developed Australian suspension calibration.

Major powertrain revolution: SAIC D20 2.0L Bi-Turbo diesel engine delivering 160kW and 500Nm, ZF 8-speed automatic transmission, Pro and LUXE trims, and the stretched Megatub model with an 1,800mm long cargo tray.

Australia's first commercially available factory electric ute. Powered by an 88.5kWh lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery pack, rear-axle permanent magnet motor delivering 130kW and 310Nm, CCS2 DC fast charging, and up to 330km WLTP range.

models_catalog.name: Deliver 9
models_catalog.overview: One of Australia's top-selling large commercial vans, challenging the Toyota HiAce and Ford Transit on fleet cost-efficiency.

generations.summary: 2.0L Turbo Diesel (110kW/375Nm) with 6-speed auto/manual, autonomous emergency braking, and pure-electric eDeliver 9.
